text: YHWH reigns, let the earth rejoice, let the many shores be glad!
Cloud and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice [are] the foundation of His throne.
A fire goes out before His face, and burns up His adversaries round about.
His lightnings give light [to] the world; the earth sees, and trembles.
The mountains are melted like wax from before the face of YHWH, from before the face of the Lord of all the earth.
The heavens declare His righteousness, and all the peoples see His glory.
Let all those serving a carved image be put to shame, those boasting in idols! Bow down to Him, all gods!
Zion hears and is glad; the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of Your judgments, O YHWH.
For You, O YHWH-Elyon, [are] over all the earth; greatly are You exalted over all gods.
O lovers of YHWH, hate evil; He preserves the souls of His holy ones; from the hand of the wicked He delivers them.
Light shines on the righteous, and gladness for the upright of heart.
Be glad, O righteous ones, in YHWH, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness!
